evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jules: 'This should take me about five to ten minutes or so and then I'll get you an accurate quote and get you scheduled. Does that work for you?' — framing present but truncated from the full script version, and rushes into probing rather than waiting for full affirmation before pivoting to logistics.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jules: 'Aside from the quote and the move itself. Do you have any particular concerns about your upcoming move?' — asked, but only after the customer has already given day preference and Jules has begun gathering details. Should have been asked before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says 'No' to concerns and immediately offers destination info instead. No concerns were raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment/house), floor (5th, no freight elevator), rooms (1 bed at origin, 2 bed at destination), walking distance (not asked but not required), big items (bed, couch, chairs, TV stand, TV, dining table, paintings), special considerations (freight elevator issue, items to garage, wife's furniture already there), second address destination covered. All or nearly all seven items touched.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Jules: 'Do you need help packing or are you planning to have everything boxed up and ready?' — offered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Jules: 'How many boxes the estimate you would have on move day?' — asked, customer says 'less than ten' and other items wrapped.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jules: 'I think this, we will just take anywhere from six and a half to seven and a half hours with an estimated cost of $2,221... $22,415.' Gives range (6.5–7.5 hrs, ~$2,221) and personalizes to items listed and garage drop-off scenario. Both present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jules discloses $194/hr rate, $960 transportation fee, includes gas/truck/taxes/insurance/tools/reassembly/blankets/wrapping, no fuel/disassembly/hidden fees. Mentions 'you only pay after everything is completed with the actual time used.' Full transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Jules never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any variant. Customer responds 'Sure. Okay, sounds very simple.' but Jules initiated this, not the rep asking and holding silence.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Both guarantees missing, no version of 'Does that put those to rest?' asked.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Jules says 'if you have any questions, feel free to reach back out' at the very end — throwaway phrasing, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you?' version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Jules never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' Customer volunteers info about building location, freight elevator, parking at end, but rep never posed the catch-all question.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Jules never explicitly asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' The call simply proceeds to scheduling without an affirmative ask for the business. Customer commits ('we're confirmed for next Tuesday') but only because Jules already confirmed availability and time slot, not because of an explicit request for the business.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (Tuesday, October 6th), time (8:30–9 AM), phone number (512-961-2999), addresses (origin and destination both confirmed), arrival window confirmed. Missing: crew size, notes left for crew about customer concerns (freight elevator issue, garage drop-off, etc. mentioned but not explicitly captured as crew notes). Partial.

top_strength: Jules gathered complete logistics details (property types, floors, items, special considerations like the freight elevator and garage situation) and delivered a fully transparent, anchor + personalized estimate with clear fee breakdown and hourly rate, making the pricing easy to understand.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Agenda) was asked after probing had started, Sections 5 (Two Promises) were skipped entirely, Section 6 (Concerns Again) used a throwaway question instead of a genuine concern check, Section 7 never included an explicit ask for the business — the rep booked the customer into a slot but never actually closed with 'Would you like our help with your move?'
